Delhi sees over 6,500 lung cancer cases, one death every three days since 2020

Since 2020, Delhi has recorded 6,581 cases of lung cancer, with one death occurring approximately every three days. This data pertains to prominent Delhi hospitals over a six-year period, encompassing cases reported since 2020.
